name: Magnetic (Fridge)
headline: Custom Fridge Magnets for Everyday Brand Visibility
shortDescription: Custom fridge magnets for business promotions, service reminders, calendars, and local customer handouts.
body: Fridge magnets keep your business information visible in homes, offices, and customer workspaces.
Options include business card magnets, round magnets, calendar magnets, and other promotional shapes.
